rows.claim: Community N1:87 focuses on NLP, planning, and causal inference with strong ties to Indian IITs and IBM Research.
Research community L0:122 focuses on Causal Inference with growing 2024-2025 activity.
Research community L0:47 focuses on multimodal learning with rising CLIP and GPT-4o adoption.
Clustering research in defense and top-tier institutions.
Community N1:42: Graph Neural Networks and Vision-Language Learning.

The enriched AAAI and IJCAI 2021-2025 knowledge graph includes research communities focused on graph learning tasks, graph neural networks for knowledge graph completion, knowledge editing and multi-hop QA, and efficient systems and trustworthy ML.

demos.title: Local GraphRAG overview of graph neural networks
demos.question: Summarize graph neural networks research and related benchmarks in this corpus.

result.question: Summarize graph neural networks research and related benchmarks in this corpus.
result.answer: Graph neural networks research in this corpus centers on methods like graph networks (4 papers) and graph convolutional neural networks (6 papers), primarily applied to node classification tasks and graph representation learning. Key datasets include the Open Graph Benchmark (3 papers). Research communities show Graph Machine Learning as the dominant topic with 1279 papers, while graph neural networks account for 296 papers. Specific applications include knowledge graph completion using datasets like Pubmed and Cora, and vision-language learning involving video classification and out-of-distribution generalization.
